Markon is hiring Software Engineers at multiple skill levels to develop, integrate, maintain, and optimize mission-critical software systems and infrastructure. Responsibilities
Design, develop, maintain, and enhance complex software systems and applications based on mission requirements
Develop and support containerized applications and infrastructure using Python, Kubernetes, Docker, and Helm
Analyze system requirements and contribute to software design, architecture, integration, and performance optimization
Develop, test, and integrate software components while ensuring compliance with technical and operational requirements
Troubleshoot software defects, system performance issues, and integration challenges
Support system engineering activities, including requirements analysis, system design, integration, testing, and documentation
Evaluate hardware and software tradeoffs, software reuse, and integration of commercial and government solutions
Develop and maintain technical documentation, test procedures, and system configuration records
Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams and provide direct technical support to customer stakeholders
Identify opportunities for automation, process improvement, and enhanced system reliability
